contract: Render each shot natively in 4K, encode a 1440 x 1440 web copy with the command in direction/astra-requests.md, save it as public/<output>, set ready to true for its key in src/motion.json, run npm test, and log the take in film/requests/ledger.csv. The scroll uses a clip only when ready is true; until then its straight cut or code-built move plays.

defaults.takes: Render two or three 4K takes per shot and keep the best; no drafts.
defaults.second_opinion: kling4_0 image-to-video at 4k with the same start_image and end_image, for any shot Seedance cannot land

shots.where: End of room 1, Dusk til Dawn → Blackout photographs
shots.prompt: A five-second continuous shot that begins exactly on this oil painting: a black canvas with white paint flecks above a blue and orange painted head. The camera drifts slowly toward the white flecks at the upper right. One by one the flecks catch light and glint like reflections from a mirror ball while the painted head recedes into the dark. The glints spread across the black until the frame settles exactly on the final image: a black-and-white triptych of mirrored cowboy hats under the glowing word BLACKOUT. Keep the painted brushwork intact in the first second and the lettering BLACKOUT exact in the last second. No new faces, no figures appearing in the black, no other text, no strobing. Silent.
shots.protect: The painted head and flecks in the first second; the BLACKOUT lettering in the last second
shots.discard_if: The flecks rearrange before they glint, a face appears in the black, or the letters warp

shots.where: Last image of room 2, Blackout photographs
shots.prompt: A very slow, steady dolly forward into this black-and-white photograph of an entirely empty hall with tall windows and a polished floor. The small black stand on its rectangular weighted base at mid-distance stays fixed exactly where it is. No person or human silhouette appears. Shift the polished floor reflection only as the perspective changes. Maintain the same strictly straight vertical window mullions and stop before reaching the stand. No extra text. Silent.
shots.protect: The original stand with a weighted rectangular base and the straight window grid
shots.discard_if: The stand changes shape, a person appears, or the window grid bends

shots.where: End of room 4, Artful and Grateful → Domus Dei
shots.prompt: Begins exactly on this night photograph of a flame burning above its soft reflection. The flame rises and flickers up out of the top of the frame. As the camera tilts up, its warm light settles on the gold tesserae of a dark church dome, and the shot lands exactly on the final image: a gilded mosaic dome interior in deep shadow with a small window of light. Keep the flame's reflection unchanged for the first second. No candles, no lamps, no people, no text. Silent.
shots.protect: The flame and its reflection in the first second; the dome's architecture in the last second
shots.discard_if: The flame becomes a candle or a lamp, a figure appears, or the dome's arches warp

shots.where: End of room 5, Domus Dei → To Bleed in Liquid Gold
shots.prompt: Begins on this fresco: a starry blue vault with a glowing gold medallion that holds a painted face. The camera pushes slowly into the medallion's gold ring, keeping the ring centred and the same size on screen. As the push continues, the fresco gives way to a handmade red sculpture with torn gold leaf, and the ring becomes the gold-leafed rim of an opening in the sculpture, landing exactly on the final image. The painted face does not morph into anything; it passes out of frame with the push. Keep the gold leaf edges and the red surface. No people, no text. Silent.
shots.protect: The ring's position and size on screen; the gold leaf edges of the landing frame
shots.discard_if: The medallion's face morphs into the sculpture, the rim changes shape, or the ring jumps position

shots.where: Room 10, Fly, after the blocks become the waterfront
shots.prompt: This photograph shows four moments of one jump by the same person in a red hood and blue jeans, frozen in mid-air along a diagonal above a river. Keep all four figures completely frozen exactly as photographed: pose, hood, face, hands and feet do not move at all. Only the world around them moves: clouds drift slowly to the right, the river surface ripples and glints, leaves on the far trees stir. The camera does not move. End on the same frame as it began. No new figures, no text. Silent.
shots.protect: All four figures, every pixel of pose, hood, face, hands and shoes; the diagonal they make
shots.discard_if: Any figure moves, blurs or changes, a fifth figure appears, or the waterfront edge shifts

shots.where: Room 5, Domus Dei, the dusk moon
shots.prompt: This is a collage: a white field on the left, a grainy blue dusk sky on the right, and in the middle a photograph of a bell tower silhouette beside a construction crane, with a thin crescent moon and one bright star. Keep the collage layout and its borders exactly. Inside the photographs only, the sky slowly deepens from evening blue toward night, and a few windows on the building at the lower right begin to glow warm. The moon and the star stay exactly where they are. The crane stays. Nothing else moves. No added stars, no text. Silent.
shots.protect: The collage borders, the moon and star positions, the crane
shots.discard_if: The moon or star moves, extra stars appear, the collage edges shift, or the crane disappears

shots.where: End of room 6, To Bleed in Liquid Gold → Record-store shoot
shots.prompt: Begins on this handmade red sculpture with gold leaf. The camera pushes into the gold-rimmed opening at its centre. The dark opening and its gold rim begin to turn slowly, like a record on a turntable, and become the red label of a vinyl record held up by two hands, landing exactly on the final image: a person in a blue PHILA 3 jersey holding two records over their face in a crowded record store. Keep the hands, the PHILA 3 lettering and both record labels exact in the last second. No new people, no extra text. Silent.
shots.protect: The hands, the PHILA 3 lettering and the record labels in the landing frame
shots.discard_if: The hands deform, the lettering changes, or a face appears behind the records

shots.where: Landing, her light: the photograph behind the rays (lab/rays)
shots.prompt: A six-second locked-off shot of this exact photograph that begins and ends on the same frame, so it loops. The camera does not move at all. Only a few loose strands of her hair stir as if in a faint draught, and the light on her face breathes very slightly, as from a handheld lamp. Her face, eyes, nose, mouth and profile stay exactly as in the photograph: she does not blink, speak or turn. The room and her shadow on the wall stay still. Keep the film grain and the soft focus. No new light, no colour change, no camera movement. Silent.
shots.protect: Her profile line (forehead, nose, lips, chin) pixel for pixel in every frame, because the rays meet it in code; her eyes and mouth. Lock them with the lock-fly-motion method.
shots.discard_if: Her profile or features move by more than two pixels at 1080, she blinks or her mouth moves, the frame drifts or zooms, or the first and last frames differ

shots.where: Landing, her light: the first three seconds, before the rays grow
shots.prompt: Three seconds in a dark room. The frame begins almost black on this exact composition. A single handheld light switches on from the left, out of frame, where she is looking, and finds her face: the light rises quickly on her cheek, nose and forehead, then the room settles exactly into the final photograph. The camera does not move. Her pose, profile and expression never change. No flicker after the first second, no colour cast, no lens flare, no new objects. Silent.
shots.protect: The final photograph in the last half-second, exactly; her profile in every frame
shots.discard_if: Her face or pose changes, the light comes from the right, or the last frame differs from the photograph

experiments.title: A score that follows the light

stems.night: Instrumental, 84 BPM, D minor. Late-night city air, soft sub bass, brushed hi-hats far away, a warm Rhodes chord that never resolves. Sparse, intimate, a party heard through a wall.
stems.gold: Instrumental, 84 BPM, D minor. A slow organ-like pad in a stone church, one sustained choir-like vowel synthesised (no words), a single bell every eight bars. Reverent but modern.
stems.neon: Instrumental, 84 BPM, D minor. Dusty boom-bap drums, vinyl crackle, a chopped soul sample feel, playful bass. A record store at closing time.
stems.day: Instrumental, 84 BPM, D major. Bright guitar arpeggios, open air, light percussion like footsteps, a wide sky. A jump into sunlight over water.
stems.studio: Instrumental, 84 BPM, D major. Solo piano and soft room tone, a fan humming, pencil-like brush textures. Quiet pride, the end of a long day in the studio.

experiments.output: public/motion/E3-<chapter>.mp3 (192 kbps, loudness matched to -23 LUFS)
experiments.use: Off by default. One small sound toggle beside the mark; the scroll crossfades stems by chapter. Opus integrates it.
experiments.discard_if: Any vocals or words, a tempo or key that does not match the other stems, or anything that sounds like a named artist

experiments.title: The circle, in one 4K HDR shot
experiments.prompt: One continuous camera push through four circles, landing exactly on each supplied frame in order: a gold halo on a starry blue fresco, the gold-leafed rim of an opening in a red handmade sculpture, the red label of a vinyl record held up by two hands, and an orange painted basketball held by a child. Each circle holds the centre of the frame as the material around it changes. No new people, no text. Silent.
experiments.use: Compared against H4 and H7. If it wins, it could open the coda as the film's recurring circle, or replace both bridges.
experiments.discard_if: Any of the four landing frames is missed, or hands or lettering deform

experiments.title: Material versions of the code-built moves

shots.prompt: The sheet taped to the light table lifts by itself, folds open like paper, and becomes the photograph of a child holding a basketball in front of an orange armchair, landing exactly on the final image. Real paper, real light, one continuous move.
The square print turns over in real space like a card on a table, its back revealing the second print: a woman with a raised arm on the same pale blue field, landing exactly on the final image.
Three tall black panels fall into frame one after another like stage flats, covering the painting and landing exactly as the three vertical panels of the BLACKOUT triptych.

experiments.use: Each replaces its code-built move only if it looks better in context; otherwise the code move stays.
experiments.discard_if: The landing frame is missed, or her picture changes before the move begins

v2.audio_contract: Instrumental, no voices or words, nothing that imitates a named artist. 84 BPM, D tonal centre, so any two tracks crossfade. Loudness -18 LUFS integrated, true peak -1 dBTP. MP3 192 kbps stereo, 44.1 kHz.

notes.what: Fifteen soft plucked-harp notes, one per ray, so that sliding a finger across her light plays a scale.
notes.method: Generate one clean, dry, single pluck at D4 (about 2 s with its natural decay, no reverb tail cut off). Then pitch it to each note with rubberband so the tuning is exact, for example: rubberband -p <semitones> pluck-D4.wav note-01.wav.
notes.order: note-01 is the lowest and belongs to the first ray (night, low in front of her face); note-15 the highest (daylight white, behind her).
notes.discard_if: Any note sounds like a different instrument from the others, or carries room noise

sounds.prompt: A soft glass shimmer that travels from the right speaker to the left, like light sweeping across a room. Bright but gentle, no whoosh.
A short warm swell of air and light as a door of light opens; no impact, no whoosh.
Three tall panels landing one after another, soft wooden thuds
A rush of air through an opening window
A camera flash firing and recharging
A card turning over on a table

living.what: At most one living still per work, where only light, water, sky, smoke, flame or fabric moves and every figure, face, hand, letter and border holds pixel for pixel (the lock-fly-motion.py method). H5 (Fly) and H6 (Domus Dei) already count.
living.first: Before rendering, propose the slide and the motion for each work in direction/astra-feedback.md. Opus agrees or redirects in the same file.
living.settings: Seedance 2.5 omni_reference, 4k, 1:1, 5 s, start and end frame both the slide, so it loops
living.output: motion/V-<slide>.mp4, with a key in src/motion.json
